base_ledger_format: Each LF-terminated line is `<lowercase sha256><two spaces><mirror-relative path>`, byte-sorted by path.
base_scope: Every existing mirror/grammar/**/*.ts file. The frozen base contains rejected historical architecture only as an integration-drift witness; it grants that architecture no credit.
candidate_close_receipt: candidate tree Git hash-object when available
projection: Replace or add each allowed overlay path verbatim atop the frozen base, then regenerate the complete byte-sorted grammar ledger. No formatter, import rewrite, barrel edit, or generated shim occurs during projection.
review_identity: The quintetto and synthesis triumvirate review the candidate source hash, overlay-ledger hash, and projected aggregate-ledger hash as one indivisible identity.
integration: Root applies the selected overlay bytes verbatim to target_path, verifies the selected source hash and projected aggregate-ledger hash, and then runs semantic/type/benchmark replay.
drift_rule: Any base-ledger drift, extra import, rewritten byte, target collision, or aggregate mismatch starts a new generation before selection. Later retirement of the rejected base is a separate tree change and requires an integration replay under the then-current feature-law authority.
